contract.purpose: Define the shell-facing service interface before implementation is backed by real system services.

components.name: AppLaunch
components.returns: launch result with explicit failure reason when unavailable
components.notes: Must go through desktop environment or session launcher, not arbitrary shell execution.

components.name: WindowStatus
components.interface: query active window, geometry, workspace, fullscreen, focus
components.notes: Real platform APIs only; stubs must report Unavailable or RequiresConfiguration when unsupported.

components.name: Dock
components.notes: Owned by the shell; persisted through Settings.

components.name: Settings
components.notes: Storing preferences is real; changing system state must be delegated to the relevant service.

components.name: Notifications
components.interface: send, dismiss, mark read, list recent
components.notes: Use native desktop notification APIs where available.

components.name: Search
components.interface: query apps, files, settings, shortcuts, assistant actions
components.notes: Results must come from real sources; empty results are valid, fabricated results are not.

components.name: ControlCenter
components.interface: open, toggle, read device state for known categories
components.notes: Only enable controls when the underlying capability is detected.

components.name: Assistant
components.interface: query typed tools only; no unrestricted shell access
components.notes: Tool execution requires schema, validation, authorization, and confirmation for high-impact actions.

components.name: Cloud
components.interface: local files provider plus Google Drive provider through OAuth 2.0
components.notes: iCloud is supported only where technically honest and documented.
